The Slash J Beef Difference

Here at Slash J Beef, we are providing a product that is the culmination of over 150 years of generational knowledge.  Our cattle are raised and grazed on the same land that our family has been tending for over 4 generations.  Though ranching is in our blood—cooperate beef was also the start to our career. We offer big-beef knowledge of nutrition, quality and control, production, and processing to our direct-to-consumer philosophy.  After leaving the corporate world behind, it is our pleasure to offer you the best quality and products that we can-- bringing the ranch to your family table. 

We offer beef shares, hand selected boxes, and samplers that will allow you to enjoy the Slash J Beef brand at your convenience.  Options are available for freezer stashing, or dipping your toes into the pool to experience the Slash J quality that you have been looking for.

Shipping policy

We currently offer shipping to physical addresses within the state of Colorado.  In the future, we are working to be able to ship domestically. We use UPS shipping, and we print our shipping labels directly from Shopify, therefore we are not responsible for incorrect or incomplete shipping addresses. Our cuts of beef are individually frozen and packaged. We ship using frozen ice / dry ice in an insulated package. Items will arrive still frozen, partially thawed or still chilled. As long as your beef is still cold, it is safe to eat. If it's warm at the time of delivery, please contact us.

* Please note that shipping is not available on large beef portions. Those products must be picked up, or we can arrange for delivery within 200 miles of Fort Morgan, Co. Full Payment is due at time of processing. We will send you a second invoice when the remaining balance is known.

Customers are able to pick up their order from us in Fort Morgan, Colorado to save the cost of shipping. We are also happy to deliver orders within a 200 mile radius of Fort Morgan, Colorado.

Ground Beef, Grass Finished ground beef, sold in 1 pound packages.

$10.00 per lb. 

Each package of our single source ground beef comes from one single animal so you receive quality, mouthwatering beef unlike anything you’ve tasted before.

The cattle spend their lives on pure pastureland, benefiting from grazing on fresh, and nutritious grasses. To help keep them optimally healthy , they also have free choice to a mineral-rich mix of salt and vitamins. Our grass-fed/finished cattle are pasture raised, naturally, on the eastern plains of Colorado on our family’s ranch that has been raising cattle for over 150 years.

Each animal is humanely harvested at a processing facility less than an hour from the ranch.

To enhance its tenderness and flavor, the meat is dry aged for a minimum of two weeks before being cut, packaged and quick-frozen to preserve the impeccable quality and flavor.

Grain Finished ¼ Beef, buy in bulk and save.

Our grain finished cattle are pasture raised, naturally, on the eastern plains of Colorado on our family’s ranch that has been raising cattle for over 150 years, before being finished on a corn-based diet for a rich, wholesome beefy flavor that you are sure to love.

Each animal is humanely harvested at a processing facility less than an hour from the ranch.

To enhance its tenderness and flavor, the meat is dry aged for a minimum of two weeks before being cut, packaged and quick-frozen to preserve the impeccable quality and flavor.

10 CUBIC FEET OF FREEZER SPACE
APPROXIMATELY 290 INDIVIDUAL 6OZ SERVINGS
APPROXIMATELY 70 MEALS FOR A FAMILY OF 4
18 - 22 WEEKS SUPPLY OF BEEF ON AVERAGE
All Sales are Final.
Deposits are non-refundable.
Full payment due at time of processing and will be sent via email.
Shipping is not available on Large Beef Portions.

Fill your freezer with your favorite cuts of delicious BEEF! You can choose your steak thickness, roast size, pounds of ground beef per package, and add specialty cuts to your custom order. FREE delivery to most places in Colorado! Customers may also pick up their order in Fort Morgan, Colorado.
